# FG-INT-0007

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 410 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | [`integration-feed-lag`](../../ops/runbooks/integration-feed-lag.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `an_authentic_cursor_past_max_age_is_int_0007_retention` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: このカーソルからは続きを読めません。今の位置を取り直し、開発状況を取り直してから、その位置から読み直してください。
- en: The feed cannot continue from this cursor. Get the current position, resync the development status, then read from that position.
- id: Feed tidak dapat dilanjutkan dari kursor ini. Ambil posisi saat ini, sinkronkan ulang status pengembangan, lalu baca dari posisi tersebut.

## 原因 (cause)

`GET /api/v1/integrations/{id}/events?cursor=…` got an authentic cursor of this integration that the feed cannot continue without silently skipping events (ADR-0016 §7). The answer is 410 with `reason` in the body (the only field besides error_code, user_message and request_id): `retention` (events after the cursor were deleted by events.retention, or the cursor is older than 1.5 × the retention period), `epoch_mismatch` (the feed's epoch was rotated: `forge admin events new-epoch` after a restore or rebuild of the database), `ahead_of_head` (the cursor points past the last numbered event: the database was restored to an earlier point), `visible_set_changed` (what the integration may see changed since the cursor was issued: a project bound or unbound — an unbind and a rebind of the same project too, the binding generation is part of the set —, the service account's role, a project's deletion, or the integration's event_types). Nothing was read. Not an alert: the consumer recovers by itself.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason`, `integration_id` and, by reason, `cursor_seq` with `retained_from` (retention) or `high_seq` (ahead_of_head); never the cursor's value. SELECT epoch, high_seq, retained_from FROM forge.event_feed_state; the binding history is in the audit log: SELECT action, project_id, occurred_at FROM forge.audit_log WHERE action IN ('integration.bound', 'integration.unbound') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20.

## 対処 (fix)

The consumer (kanflow K3) follows docs/api/integration-feed.md: GET /api/v1/integrations/{id}/events/cursor first, then resync the development status (state=all), then read from the position it got. Nothing to do on the server unless the reason is unexpected (retention while the consumer was healthy: runbook integration-feed-lag).
